description: Ontology & cross-dimensional linking — defines the relationship-type vocabulary and infers edges across the temporal, geographic, linguistic, and genetic/derivation dimensions, including a dedicated discovery effort for the under-sourced linguistic and genetic dimensions, turning a flat set of category nodes into a dense connected network.

tasks.title: T3-US-001: Define the relationship-type ontology as data
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want the edge vocabulary defined formally so linkers and exporters share one source of truth.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Encode the ontology from docs/data-model.md (LOCATED_IN, CONTEMPORARY_WITH, DESCENDS_FROM, DERIVED_FROM, etc.) as a typed registry with each type's domain, range, dimension, and symmetry/transitivity flags
- Provide a lookup API and a validator that rejects edges whose :TYPE is not registered
- Tests pass (pytest) for lookup, unknown-type rejection, and symmetry/transitivity flags
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: pinakes-engine — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/pinakes_engine/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/ontology-linking'.

tasks.title: T3-US-002: Define the Linker interface and pipeline
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want pluggable linkers so each dimension's inference is isolated and composable.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Define abstract Linker with link(nodes, edges) -> new_edges and a registry by dimension
- A pipeline runs registered linkers in order and appends inferred edges, never mutating source rows
- Inferred edges are tagged with source='inferred:<linker>' and a confidence
- Tests pass (pytest) running two stub linkers through the pipeline
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T3-US-003: Implement the geographic linker (LOCATED_IN / ORIGINATES_FROM)
tasks.description:
As a user, I want entities connected to places so the network is geographically navigable.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Create or reuse place nodes from place_qid / tgn_id / pleiades_id and link entities via LOCATED_IN and ORIGINATES_FROM
- Where only lat/lon exist, attach to the nearest known place within a configurable radius and flag lower confidence
- Emit ADJACENT_TO edges between places sharing a containment/border relation when available from source data
- Tests pass (pytest) on a fixture of entities with QIDs, coords-only, and TGN ids
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T3-US-004: Implement the temporal linker (CONTEMPORARY_WITH / PRECEDES / PART_OF_PERIOD)
tasks.description:
As a user, I want entities connected in time so I can explore what coexisted or preceded what.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Emit CONTEMPORARY_WITH between entities with overlapping [time_start,time_end] spans (configurable overlap threshold)
- Emit PRECEDES/FOLLOWS for non-overlapping ordered events
- Emit PART_OF_PERIOD linking entities to named period nodes, creating period nodes idempotently
- Guard against combinatorial explosion: contemporaneity is only computed within a shared facet (category/region) unless explicitly widened
- Tests pass (pytest) for overlap, ordering, and the explosion guard
- Type checks pass (mypy)
